mapper.select: SELECT a.ADJ_NO, a.WH_CD, a.ITEM_CD, a.LOC_CD, a.BEFORE_QTY, a.ADJ_QTY, a.AFTER_QTY, a.REASON, i.ITEM_NM, w.WH_NM FROM STOCK_ADJ_HIST a JOIN ITEM_MST i ON a.ITEM_CD = i.ITEM_CD JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON a.WH_CD = w.WH_CD ORDER BY a.ADJ_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STOCK_ADJ_HIST (ADJ_NO, WH_CD, ITEM_CD, LOC_CD, BEFORE_QTY, ADJ_QTY, AFTER_QTY, REASON) VALUES (#{adjNo}, #{whCd}, #{itemCd}, #{locCd}, #{beforeQty}, #{adjQty}, #{afterQty}, #{reason})
